from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1'
assert not out.exists(),'E11目录已有，不覆盖注册。'
out.mkdir();(out/'sources').mkdir()
url='https://home.treasury.gov/policy-issues/financing-the-government/quarterly-refunding/quarterly-refunding-archives/quarterly-refunding-financing-estimates-by-calendar-year'
protocol={'study_id':'510300_TREASURY_BORROWING_REVISION_PANEL_V1','experiment_id':'E11',
 'registered_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),'phase':'SOURCE_FIRST_SEPARATE_MODEL_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED',
 'question':'全部2022Q1—2025Q4同季度借款预估修订，能否以当时原公布表连续分为起始现金、期末目标、融资需要、其他融资？',
 'previous_goal_turn_classification':'PROGRESS_E10_MATCHED_QUARTER_BORROWING_SOURCE_CAUSES',
 'fixed_current_quarters':[str(y)+'Q'+str(q) for y in range(2022,2026) for q in range(1,5)],
 'source_scope':{'official_catalog_url':url,'max_catalog_pages':1,'max_primary_release_pages':17,
 'max_current_release_tables':16,'max_concurrency':3,'attempts_per_url':2,'do_not_retry_403_429':True,
 'boundary_prior_release':'仅2022Q1所需的2021Q4前次计划，其他先前计划来自相邻本轮原文交叉核。',
 'selection':'官方实际按年公布，按当前目标季度选全16项，不选择收益或金额。',
 'support_tables':'只当前公告直接链接或同官方目录同季度列出的原资金来源/用途表；PDF/图/电子表按实际格式，不使用后来表复述回填更早事件。',
 'reuse_E10':['sources/20230501_Treasury借款预估原文.html','sources/20230731_Treasury借款预估原文.html','sources/20230731_资金来源与用途原表.pdf']},
 'fields':['本季度前次/此次私人净市场化借款','本季度原起始现金假设/此次已知实际起始现金','原/此次期末现金目标',
 '当前原表Financing Need两预估','当前原表All Other Sources两预估','SOMA兑付memo两预估，仅说明不重复计',
 '正文实际公布日期、同季度表内两预估日期、显示精度残差、债限/跨季结算说明'],
 'economic_decomposition':'Δ借款=原起始现金−实际起始现金+期末现金目标修订+Financing Need修订−All Other Sources修订+原显示残差。',
 'source_gate':'16当前季度均有同范围原字段、同季度两预估及实际公布日期，现金/借款表文交叉可核；缺源/关键字段不补0、不用后表回填、不把现金调整残余冒充Financing Need。',
 'display_precision':'保留原取整显示与残差，不强制对齐，不把残差作为经济因子；未取整精确恒等式不认证。',
 'availability':'实际美国正文日末转上海为保守公开日上界，首版/当年收件仍未认证；来源归属绑定当前公布，不回填先前预测。',
 'known_selection':'E10一例与定位搜索其他季度预览、E6/E9历史已看过；非独立历史验证。',
 'model_or_return_comparison':'来源齐后另登记；本源阶段不读股票标签、不冻结分组/符号/训练参数；季度根不能复制为周度独立事件。',
 'model_execution_requires_source_gate_and_separate_registration':True,'equity_labels_allowed_in_source_phase':False,
 'parameter_searches':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'new_repository_code_edits':0,
 'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'orders_authorized':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','goal_achieved':False}
p=out/'protocol.json';p.write_text(json.dumps(protocol,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
parent=['reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_source_qualification_v1/next_experiment.json',
 'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_source_qualification_v1/result.json',
 'reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_long_supply_cause_score_v1/sources/官方按年声明目录.html']
freeze={'registered_at':protocol['registered_at'],'before_new_quarter_fields_or_equity_labels':True,
 'protocol_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'parent_input_hashes':{rel:hashlib.sha256((root/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for rel in parent},
 'mandate_snapshot':json.loads((root/'config/510300_existing_data_training_mandate_v1.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')),
 'scope_snapshot':json.loads((root/'config/510300_historical_cause_discovery_v1.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))}
(out/'freeze.json').write_text(json.dumps(freeze,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print('E11固定16季度/17正文/16当前原表来源注册完成，模型和标签阶段尚未登记。')
